resources.string: Watch the view improve as exposures accumulate; no video recording needed
Connect the main camera, focus and center the target, then start. No recording is required. Pause and switch to a single frame while focusing or moving; reset for a new target.
Ready to start with the current camera settings.
Live single frame · the stack appears after the first accepted exposure
Camera capture is stopped. Resume capture, then continue stacking.
Recording continues · %1$d frames saved. Stacking is independent.
Find it in Files → Stack results. PNG is ready to view; FITS preserves the linear data.
1 Choose a recording → 2 Analyze quality → 3 Stack the best frames → 4 Adjust and save. Start with the full frame if unsure about ROI.
Your SER/PSER recordings appear here automatically, newest first. You do not need to find an Android folder.
No completed SER/PSER recordings yet. Record a video in SER or PSER on the camera page, then return here. MP4 and still photos cannot be stacked in this workflow.
The current recording is still being written. Stop recording before selecting it for analysis.
Set SER and go to camera
Only the display changes. EAA adjusts the first accepted stack once; use this button again if needed.
Not enough varying signal for an automatic stretch. Keep accumulating or adjust brightness manually.
